# Vendored Front-End Libraries

These minified bundles are vendored so `workflow_map.html` renders the Lineage tab
without a network connection. Versions and licenses below; refresh by re-running
`curl` against the same `unpkg.com/<pkg>@<version>` URLs.

| File | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cytoscape.min.js` | 3.30.2 | MIT | https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape.js |
| `dagre.min.js` | 0.8.5 | MIT | https://github.com/dagrejs/dagre |
| `cytoscape-dagre.min.js` | 2.5.0 | MIT | https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape.js-dagre |

The Lineage tab loads them with plain `<script src="vendor/...">` tags from
`docs/workflow_map.html`. Cross-run lineage data is generated by
`scripts/build_lineage_graph.py` and written to
`ResearchPartner-runs/_index/lineage_graph.json`.
